utterance: Hi, Daniel. What happened to your back on the weekend?
reply: I hurt it on Saturday lifting a big pot plant in the garden, felt a bit of a twinge, and then woke up Sunday and could barely get out of bed, so it has been about three days now. It is low down on the left side of my back, and sometimes it goes into my left buttock. It is worse when I bend or get out of a chair, and worse by the evening, though it feels a bit better when I am lying still with a heat pack. I have worked from home the last two days mostly lying on the couch with the laptop, and I can walk around slowly.
